input.headline: Mechanical Engineer seeking for new opportunity in Renewable Energy sector
input.about: I am mechanical engineer with experience of design of HVAC system for commercial buildings. In my current company I am doing the load calculation and the duct design in AutoCAD and Revit. I have done also one project of solar water heating for hospital in my home country. I am hard worker and fast learner and I am very interest in renewable energy field. I am having valid work permit.

goldFacts: I design HVAC systems for commercial buildings.
I do load calculations and duct design in AutoCAD and Revit.
I worked on a solar water heating project for a hospital in my home country.
I am interested in the renewable energy field.
I have a valid work permit.

traps.text: Designed HVAC systems for 20 commercial buildings.
Led the solar water heating project for a hospital.
Reduced the hospital's energy costs with the solar system.

notes: Non-native English. The rewrite should fix grammar but keep the content; 'done one project' must not become 'led'.
